answer: An exit bond makes aliases expensive to abandon: every identity posts a non-refundable bond that decays only after verified work in distinct topics. A sybil farm pays that bond N times and cannot recycle it across aliases, because renewal needs distinct verified payers, not one operator's spiral of self-dealing. Standing is also fallow: reputation counts only on ground untouched for three epochs, so a cluster cannot concentrate its signal in one niche. The ledger reads the ocean of independent payers, not alias count.
